status: parent accepted after independent design-boundary review: APPROVE
unchanged: Strict persisted r2 WorkflowContract, CurrentDesign, Ledger, Event, Receipt and GuardSnapshot schemas
Only requires edges own dependencies; no persisted reverse graph
evaluate performs no I/O, callbacks or global-cache reads
Standalone measurement and evidence.py remain independent of workflow

resolved_ledger.receipts: Mapping from ledger-referenced receipt ID to ReceiptObservation, including recursively referenced prerequisites

ReceiptObservation.observed_sha256: Observed immutable file-byte hash or null
ReceiptObservation.artifacts: Mapping of declared artifact paths to observations of existence, expected/observed hash and byte length
ReceiptObservation.reason: Explicit diagnostic, empty only for valid observations

resolved_ledger.rules: Resolve only validated relative receipt/artifact paths inside the workspace/root boundary. Reject links and traversal before reading. Cyclic receipt references are invalid, never recursive overflow. Missing, changed or malformed referenced proof becomes an explicit observation, never a pass. Invalid top-level ledger or contract is an input error.

resolved_inputs.targets: Mapping of canonical kind:id to current GuardSnapshot or explicit blocked observation for each recursively required target
resolved_inputs.rules: Derive membership and prerequisite closure from the validated requires graph. Include member actions when evaluating increment/ship. Hash each target's own normalized FileScope, preserving directory membership, missing declared paths and exact exclusions. Do not compare a target-wide digest to a different prerequisite scope.

public_boundary.load_workspace: Returns (WorkflowContract, CurrentDesign, ResolvedLedger), with resolved views represented by named ordinary Python dataclasses or TypedDicts in workflow_state.py
public_boundary.bind_inputs: Returns ResolvedInputs for the requested target and its derived dependency closure
public_boundary.evaluate: evaluate(contract, resolved_ledger, resolved_inputs, target) -> Readiness; consumes materialized values only
public_boundary.serialization: Event.inputs, Receipt.inputs and Readiness.inputs serialize only the existing target GuardSnapshot, never resolved views, receipt maps or handles
public_boundary.locking: CLI freshly loads and binds under its already-held lock before decisions and append/admission; read-only status may observe a concurrent change and is not permission to dispatch
public_boundary.dependency_direction: workflow_gate may import pure types/helpers from workflow_state; workflow_state must not import workflow_gate. Persistence does not invoke decision logic.

acceptance: A matching pass event with a missing/tampered receipt or artifact still blocks.
A valid receipt in another target's different scope is compared to that target's current scope.
Changes reopen affected dependency chains without invalidating unrelated receipt IDs or bytes.
evaluate runs on materialized fixture views without filesystem access.
Current checks and historical before-action consumed checks keep distinct freshness semantics.
Resolved views are absent from persisted JSON; unknown persisted keys remain rejected.
